# Pulse

> Local-first desktop analytics and Discord Rich Presence for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Command Code and Orion App. Track tokens, API-equivalent costs, prompt cache, context-window fill and provider allowances on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Key facts:

- Checkout version: 2.1.0; shared Codex core: 2.0.1 through an immutable Git pin.
- Rust, Tauri 2, Svelte 5 and SQLite; Rust 1.99.1 and Bun 1.4.4 development tooling.
- Provider stores are read-only and separate from Pulse-owned analytics under PULSE_HOME.
- Missing cost or context is unavailable, not zero; API-equivalent estimates are not provider invoices.
- Analytics schema 7, Claude config schema 6 and Codex config schema 13.
- Local builds, published packages and installed native acceptance are separate evidence.
- Full local gate: cargo xtask check. Workflows and publication are manual-only.
